    assert check_if_last_char_is_a_letter("apple pie") == False
    assert check_if_last_char_is_a_letter("apple pie e!") == False # 'e!' isn't a lone letter

    # Last char is not a letter -> False
    assert check_if_last_char_is_a_letter("hello world!") == False
    assert check_if_last_char_is_a_letter("hello 1") == False

    # Edge cases
    assert check_if_last_char_is_a_letter("") == False             # empty string
    assert check_if_last_char_is_a_letter("   ") == False          # spaces only

def test_check_if_last_char_is_a_letter():
    # Core behavior: last char is a letter AND forms its own word
    assert check_if_last_char_is_a_letter("apple pi e") == True    # 'e' alone
    assert check_if_last_char_is_a_letter("apple pi") == True      # 'i' alone
    assert check_if_last_char_is_a_letter("a") == True             # single letter
    assert check_if_last_char_is_a_letter("A") == True             # uppercase works

    # Last char is a letter but part of a longer word -> False
    assert check_if_last_char_is_a_letter("apple pie") == False
    assert check_if_last_char_is_a_letter("apple pie e!") == False # 'e!' isn't a lone letter

    # Last char is not a letter -> False
    assert check_if_last_char_is_a_letter("hello world!") == False
    assert check_if_last_char_is_a_letter("hello 1") == False

    # Edge cases
    assert check_if_last_char_is_a_letter("") == False             # empty string
    assert check_if_last_char_is_a_letter("   ") == False          # spaces only
    assert check_if_last_char_is_a_letter("hello ") == False       # trailing space
    assert check_if_last_char_is_a_letter("a  b") == True          # multiple spaces

    print("All tests passed.")
